summary.text: Luciano Floridi is a philosopher of information who was Professor of Philosophy and Ethics of Information at the Oxford Internet Institute from May 2013 to July 2023 and director of its Digital Ethics Lab, and from July 2023 founding director of the Digital Ethics Center at Yale University, where he is John K. Castle Professor in the Practice of Cognitive Science. He co-authored the 2018 Nature Human Behaviour paper proposing an ethical framework for the digital afterlife industry.
